Name: TimeGT
Description: Find the total time, within a range, when an attribute value is greater than a specified value. Time returned is in seconds.

Arguments.name: attname
Arguments.description: The name of an attribute with a PI point data reference, enclosed in single quotation marks

Arguments.name: starttime
Arguments.description: time expression representing the beginning of a time range enclosed in single quotes; can be a relative time (such as '-3h') in reference to an absolute endtime

Arguments.name: endtime
Arguments.description: time expression representing the end of a time range enclosed in single quotes; can be a relative time (such as '+1h') in reference to an absolute starttime

Arguments.name: x
Arguments.description: The reference value of the search; must be an enumeration set (string), integer or real number

Returns: The total time (in seconds), within a range, when an attribute value is greater than a given value
Notes: TimeGT interpolates between events, if necessary, to find the times when the attribute value crossed the specified value TimeGT Bad values are excluded from TimeGT calculation TimeGT

Example.description: [Find the total time between 12:00 and 1:00am today when 'att1' was greater than 80]
[Find the total time in the past hour when the value of 'att1' was greater than the value at 8am today. Result is in seconds]
